subject: Post-discovery: schedule infra runthrough + data-scope alignment
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule infra runthrough + data-scope alignment

Thanks for the call today, Jordan — good conversation and helpful context on AxonData's latency and data-retention constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a 60–90 minute technical runthrough with our ML + infra team.

What we want to achieve in the runthrough:
- Validate performance targets on your expected 1–5k QPS profile (p99 target < 200ms for short prompts)
- Walk through data flow, retention, and key compliance controls (SOC2 implications)
- Discuss long-running session KV cache behavior and cost tradeoffs (batching/quantization suggestions)
- Confirm roles (who from your side needs access / Console preview) and follow-on mutual action items

Proposed 60–90 minute windows (all times PT):
- Tue 30 Nov, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 1 Dec, 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2 Dec, 08:30–10:00

Please tell us which slot works best and who will attend from AxonData (names + roles). Also attach a quick attendee roster so we can bring the right Redwood engineers (we’ll include an infra lead + ML runtime engineer).

I’ve attached a short pre-call readout and a one-page scope questions worksheet to help steer the runthrough.

Attachments: [pre-call-readout.pdf (12 KB)], [scope-questions.xlsx (9 KB)]

Thanks — I’ll hold the windows on my calendar until I hear back.

— Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lewis <j.lewis@axondata.com>

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule infra runthrough + data-scope alignment

Thanks Marcus — appreciated the recap. Wed 1 Dec 13:00–14:30 PT works best for us. I’ll be joined by our CTO Priya Shah and our platform engineer Tomas Rivera (tomas.rivera@axondata.com).

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can you share a short (1–2 page) pre-read focused on data flow and how Redwood handles customer data (encryption at rest/in transit, retention windows, and delete paths)?
2) We’ll need to confirm whether we can run an initial pilot in our AWS account (VPC peering) and what the onboarding steps look like for Private deployments — is SOC2 / security evidence available for review?

Recording the session is fine. Also, we prefer an invite with a calendar attachment so our Schedulers can accept.

Jordan Lewis
Head of AI Platform | AxonData
j.lewis@axondata.com | +1-206-555-0144

Thanks, Jordan — we’ll lock Wed 1 Dec 13:00–14:30 PT. Looping in Soojin (Infra lead) and Alex (runtime) from our side.

Quick answers to your asks:
- We have a 2-page data-flow pre-read we can send before the runthrough. I’ve uploaded it to Drive (link below) and will attach a redacted SOC2 compliance summary suitable for procurement review.
- Pilot options: we support Hosted API for fastest kickoff, Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput, and Private (VPC) deployment for pilots that require network isolation. For a VPC pilot we typically do: network onboarding (VPC peering or shared VPC), key exchange (KMS integration), baseline perf run, and audit logging enabled for the pilot window.

Updated agenda (60–90 min):
1) 10 min: goals + attendee introductions
2) 30–35 min: architecture walk (data flows, network, auth) — Soojin + Marcus
3) 20 min: runtime demo & perf profile (Alex) — live perf on a representative prompt set
4) 10–20 min: ops & billing considerations (batching/kv-cache/cost levers) — Marcus
5) 10 min: Q&A & next steps (mutual action plan)

We’ll prepare the pre-read and a short SOC2 redacted summary. Can you confirm whether Tomas needs Console preview access for the runthrough (read-only) or full onboarding?

Drive pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bAxon-PreRead

— Mina Haddad
Customer Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
